data.explanation: This is a private invoice (Privatrechnung) from the occupational therapy practice Ergotherapie Beispielhand for ten therapy sessions and a report to the paediatrician, treating your daughter between September and November 2026, prescribed by a private prescription dated 1 September 2026. The total of €430.00 is exempt from VAT under §4 No.14 UStG. Please transfer the amount to the stated IBAN by the deadline shown, calculated as 21 days after the invoice date. If you don't pay in time, the practice may send a reminder or charge late fees, though none are stated here. Keep this invoice as it may be relevant if you claim extraordinary medical expenses on your tax return.
